answer: An agent economy can register identities through commit-reveal rounds: each epoch, applicants first submit only a salted hash commitment, then reveal identity details one epoch later. A sybil farmer cannot adapt fakes to the delta between the announced roster and the final one, and cannot batch-forge identities on a mesa of cheap keys because every reveal must match its prior commitment or burn. The pipeline advances like a glacier - exactly one fixed step per epoch, never rushed. One honest agent reveals once; a thousand fakes need a thousand valid reveals, each traceable on the ledger.
